evidence_span.text: DGAT2 inhibition increased the ER content of PE, which blocked SREBP-1 movement from the ER to Golgi for cleavage.

reviews.rationale: DGAT2 perturbation (inhibitor, liver-specific knockout, and overexpression in mouse/rat) causally establishes it as a regulator linking TG synthesis to SREBP-1 cleavage in direct mouse hepatic MASLD context, matching the regulator description. Acss2/Fdft1/Hmgcs1 (ACSS-2, squalene synthase, HMG-CoA synthase) appear only as SREBP-target pathway readouts, so no supplied gene is substantively investigated and supplied-gene arrays stay empty for this perturbation-regulator citation.
